name: g1-vr-teleop
description: Teleoperate a Unitree G1's arms and Dex3 hands from a Meta Quest 3 in VR, with optional recording of each session as a training episode (joint states, commands and camera frames).

variables.name: HTTPS_PORT
variables.description: HTTPS port for the headset page and the operator console. WebXR needs HTTPS, so the app serves a self-signed certificate that the headset accepts once.

variables.name: HTTP_PORT
variables.description: Plain-HTTP port for the same pages. Only a headset on USB (adb reverse, reached as localhost) uses it; over Wi-Fi the headset needs HTTPS_PORT. Change it if another app on the robot already listens here.

variables.name: WALKING
variables.description: on lets the Quest's left stick walk and turn the robot while armed (bounded speed, still behind the console's walking permission). off keeps the legs under the robot's own controller only.

variables.name: RECORDING
variables.description: on adds data collection: start and stop a session from the console and each one is saved on the robot as a sealed training episode. off removes the recording controls and endpoints.

variables.name: TASK
variables.description: The language instruction recorded with every session, e.g. 'Pick up the cup and place it on the plate'. GR00T and LeRobot policies are trained on (camera, joints, commands, instruction). The console asks for it at Start session; this is the default when it is left empty. No quotes, backslashes, braces or $.
variables.prompt: Task instruction recorded with each session (optional)

variables.name: NETWORK_INTERFACE
variables.description: Interface on the G1's computer with the robot-network address (192.168.123.x). Leave as auto unless detection fails.

variables.name: DDS_DOMAIN
variables.description: DDS domain: 0 drives the real robot, 1 drives a Unitree simulator on the same network.
